name: Navalosa (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically into three stripes of green, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalosa (roundels on red and a bridge on white).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 29 April 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 113 of 12 June 2001); the flag is described as square in the colours green, yellow and red with the arms at the centre.
